name: Palantir Technologies

decision.rationale: HOLD — the AI-software narrative is intact and government + commercial bookings keep compounding, but at a high-30s forward multiple the stock trades on sentiment, so the same risk-off/rate pressure weighing on the rest of your high-beta book caps upside here until the regime clears.

bull: Commercial US revenue is inflecting and the AIP land-and-expand motion is the cleanest pure-play on enterprise AI adoption — durable, high-margin, founder-led.
bear: Valuation leaves no margin for error: a long-duration name priced for perfection is exactly what de-rates first when rates stay high and risk appetite contracts.
